tooltip_definitions.Product Revenue: Switching, routing platforms, and AI networking hardware systems including Arista 7800 AI Spine, 7700R, and 7060X series switches ($3,190.0M in Q3 2026, surging +66.8% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Service Revenue: Post-contract customer software support, A-Care maintenance, and advanced network operating subscriptions ($467.6M in Q3 2026, up +17.9% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Non-GAAP Gross Margin: Adjusted gross margin excluding stock-based compensation ($8.4M) and intangible asset amortization ($7.0M), reaching 64.0% in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Non-GAAP Operating Margin: Adjusted operating margin excluding stock compensation ($138.1M) and intangibles ($15.3M), expanding to a record 49.1% in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Non-GAAP Diluted EPS: Adjusted net income per share excluding stock-based awards and strategic investment gains, delivering $1.20 in Q3 2026 vs $1.08 consensus.
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Diluted EPS: Diluted earnings per share under U.S. GAAP ($1.22 in Q3 2026, up +82.1% YoY from $0.67 in Q3 2025).
tooltip_definitions.Etherlink SU-144 Architecture: Liquid-cooled open Ethernet architecture for scale-up AI networking supporting up to 144 accelerators per rack in a single hop and up to 1,024 XPUs via cross-rack topologies.
tooltip_definitions.Arista 7800 AI Spine: Flagship high-radix distributed AI spine chassis delivering high-density 800G and 1.6T Ethernet switching across clusters of up to 1 million XPUs.
tooltip_definitions.Extensible Operating System (EOS): Arista's unified, programmable Linux-based network operating system running across every device, eliminating downtime with state-sharing NetDB architecture.
tooltip_definitions.Ethernet for Scale-Up Networks (ESUN): Open standards-based networking framework developed with AMD, Arm, Broadcom, d-Matrix, Meta, Microsoft, and Qualcomm to replace proprietary GPU interconnects.
tooltip_definitions.True Free Cash Flow: Core economic cash generation deducting capital expenditures ($100.7M) and stock-based compensation ($138.1M) from operating cash flow ($1,200.9M), yielding $962.1M.
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Flow: Cash generated by operations ($1,200.9M in Q3 2026, reaching $3,977.4M YTD).
tooltip_definitions.Capital Expenditures: Reinvestment in specialized network testing infrastructure and engineering facilities ($100.7M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Reported Free Cash Flow: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditures ($1,100.2M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Cash and Marketable Securities Fortress: Combined cash ($2,288.1M) and liquid short-term marketable securities ($12,070.9M) totaling $14.36B with zero debt on the balance sheet.
tooltip_definitions.Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6): Advanced network layer deterministic multiplane routing enabling ultra-low latency, lossless AI packet transport across geographically separated data centers.
tooltip_definitions.S&P 100 Index Addition: Arista was officially inducted into the S&P 100 blue-chip index in September 2026, driving mandatory passive institutional index fund accumulation.
tooltip_definitions.Full-Year Guidance Surge: Q4 2026 guidance raised to $3.9B - $4.0B ($3,950M midpoint, +58.8% YoY), positioning FY26 revenue to surpass $13.35B.
